notes.title: Update v0.40
notes.content:
Hope you've been enjoying our game! In v0.40, we did the following:
=====
▼ Secret Keychains
・Three new keychains are now unlockable from feats and finding, well, secrets! They will not be in the GachaTime system, so be sure to check them out in the Collection for a hint!
⤷ C-C-C-C-Combo Breaker will focus on combos and offering an awesome reward for those who like to chain combos often!
⤷ RedCard is a SUPER OP keychain that'll let you banish en masse!
⤷BeachParty is our newest themed keychain, and is an absolute MUST for anyone who prefers to skip the grind unlocking keychains permanently! Grab your beach towel!

▼ New Song Variation System
・Our OST rocks, we all know that, but we also know repetitive music can be a catchy blessing and a mind numbing curse. We introduced FIFTY NINE songs from Kevin MacLeod using his Creative Commons 4.0 license, which we graciously credited him in the Credits.
⤷ Music will now rotate out during the game rounds!
⤷ Each themed keychain will now have its own unique playlist rotation!
▼ New Mini Game: Dark Mode
・ Can you handle the dark? Play with the power of memory and strategy as you traverse a darkened case and try to set a new record for a Rainbow Gacha!
▼ Quality of Life
・ GachaTime can now be quickened by selecting "Fast" in the Menu, where it will skip the entire GachaTime animation and go straight to the prizes!

・Fixed an issue with PowerCandy Capsules not fusing when they touched
・Improved quality of Pause Window
・Added a Game Mode scene to play both normal and mini games
